title: Ham and Cheese Bow Ties
description: Bow tie mac and cheese with strips of ham baked in a Colby cheese sauce and topped with Parmesan.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook bow tie pasta at a boil, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 8 to 10 minutes. Drain.

Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Whisk in flour, salt, and pepper; cook and stir until smooth and fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes. Whisk in milk, a little at a time, then bring to a boil and cook for 1 minute. Stir Colby cheese and mustard; cook, stirring occasionally, until cheese is melted. Remove from the heat and stir in pasta and ham. Pour mixture into a 2-quart baking dish and sprinkle Parmesan over top.
Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly and golden, 20 to 25 minutes.

video.description: The way to make mac & cheese better than ever is to make it homemade, and your entire family will love the surprise of switching out macaroni for fun bowtie pasta! After cooking your pasta, cook garlic in butter, then whisk in flour, salt and pepper. Slowly stir in milk to create a white sauce. Mix in mustard and Colby cheese and stir until melted. Add the pasta along with ham and pour everything into a baking dish with a topping of Parmesan cheese. Bake until bubbly and serve to a very happy family or special guests.
